You guys have my order? Here is the text from someone there:Sorry about that, thats no good. The store chat on heliumdeploy.com (or (email hidden)) can sort missing parts, just give them order Shop····. Once theyre running, more Bitcoin hash or Doge/LTC next?

Sent from Yahoo Mail for iPhone
Searched the catalog · fan screws NerdQaxe fan
Handed to the team · Screws are not a store product, so I cannot create the part order myself. Earlie

Hi Paul,

Yes, we have it. Order Shop···· is your two BSB NerdQaxe++ miners, delivered to (address hidden) on July 17. Thanks for sending the number. Now we know exactly which units need the fan screws and clip hardware.

I'm sorry this has dragged on since October 25. We don't sell those screws as a separate item in the store, so a colleague has to send them to you by hand. I've passed the request to the team with your order and model attached, so nobody has to ask you for them again. The team is offline for the weekend. They pick this up Monday at 10am ET and will reply to you here by email. Your miners stay with you and nothing needs to come back.

Until then, please don't power up a unit if the fan isn't fixed onto its heatsink. The chips overheat within minutes without it.

On what to mine next: once these two are running, I'm happy to help you compare more Bitcoin hashrate with a Doge/LTC miner. Just reply here.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
